items.body: Changes every `thor-*` binary to start a usage error with its own name, as `thor-npm: <message>`, in place of `Error: <message>`, and keeps the `Try '… --help'.` line that follows it. The change upgrades `@williamthorsen/toolbelt.cli` to 0.8.0, whose `runCli` prints the new prefix, and changes `thor-chrome`, which reports usage errors through its own renderer, to print the same prefix.

items.description: Replaces the real-time sleeps in tests with waits that do not depend on wall time, a `setImmediate` yield in the `runRdy` and `readStreamText` tests and a wait for the stub upstream's close in the `speech-proxy` disconnect test, and disables `sky-pilot/no-real-time-sleep` at the two `chrome-tools` polling loops that wait on a real external process. (#742)

items.body: Upgrades `@williamthorsen/eslint-config-typescript` from 20.1.3 to 20.2.0, which brings `eslint-plugin-unicorn` 79 and `typescript-eslint` 8.72.1, and edits the code across the packages to satisfy the rules that the new versions add. The most widespread of those rules is `unicorn/numeric-separators-style`, which now rejects a separator in a number of fewer than 5 digits, such as `1_000`.

items.description: Upgrades `vitest` and `@vitest/coverage-v8` from 4.1.12 to 5.0.5, and declares Vitest 5's required `vite` peer at 8.3.5 through the catalog in every workspace. (#632)

Adds `vitest`, `@vitest/coverage-v8`, `typescript`, and `@williamthorsen/nmr` to the workspace catalog at the versions that the root `package.json` pinned, switches the root to `catalog:` for them, and declares `vitest` as a `catalog:` dev dependency in every package, plus `typescript` and `@williamthorsen/nmr` in `readyup`. (#602)

Adds the `tb-jira` commands to `thor-jira`: `auth` stores, removes, and reports the Jira API token in the macOS keychain, `issue list` lists a project's work items, and `configure-project` reconciles a Jira Cloud project's statuses, workflow transitions, and board features against `jira-project-spec.json`, with a `--dry-run` preview. (#532)

Adds the `@williamthorsen/atlassian-tools` package with a `thor-jira` binary, which prints its help for `--help`, `-h`, or no arguments and exits with code 2 on any other argument, to hold the `tb-jira` port in #520. (#527)
